trophies: Day 6d — Fixed two bugs YOU found in your Fury Mixer arena! The finish flag now waits for the Fury Mixer to fall before it opens (no more sneaking past it), and there's a checklist under your hearts now that shows the goal and counts your progress.
Day 6c — The FURY MIXER is ready on the shelf! Boss hawks pour out of this one, not regular ones - tougher waves, bigger challenge. Look for it in the level builder under BADDIES.
Day 6b — A GIANT stone wall painting now hangs behind your arena in level 8! Big epic coliseum backdrop, way bigger than the platforms in front of it.

Day 6 — The pause menu got real buttons! KEEP PLAYING, START OVER, and LEVEL MENU - pick one with arrows or the D-pad and press jump/A to choose. START OVER resets the whole Time Trial run back to level 1, so a bad run doesn't haunt you.

Day 5c — Bug #16, caught by our tester! The hawk statues went from floating to sunk halfway into the ground. My fault twice over — I'd left a note inside the statue's own instructions, and the game can't read notes there, so it threw away the line that told the statue where to stand. Note removed. The statue now stands on the ground properly, and I took a photo of the game to PROVE it instead of just doing the sums.

Day 5b — Bug #15, caught by our tester! The hawk statues were hovering off the ground. The picture had a band of empty space under the statue's feet, so it was resting that on the ground instead of itself. Now they stand properly on the mountain.

Day 5a — THE HAWK MIXER AND HAWK PEAK — LEVEL 9! A mountain you climb cliff by cliff to a wide summit, with the HAWK MIXER waiting on top. Two more ledges take you above it so you can walk right onto its roof and stomp it — then five hawks pour out in waves and fill the sky. They land everywhere: the ground, the summit, the ledges. Painted a STONE HAWK STATUE with its wings spread and put three of them on the mountain. The exit flag stays locked until the machine falls.
Day 4r — HORDE MODE went on the board! First head-to-head: KAM 23.62 against DAD 21.26. Beaten by 2.36 seconds. That one is NOT going to stand.

Day 4q — Swapped the arena grates for a MUCH cooler one — big heavy timber posts and thick iron bars, like a proper dungeon gate. All four in Level 8 changed at once, and so did the Iron grate piece in my level builder.

Day 4p — Bug #14, caught by our tester! Slimes thrown out of the Mixer used to sail straight THROUGH the ledges and land on the floor every single time. Now the machine looks at what's under each landing spot and drops them on it — some hit the floor, some land up on the steps. Nowhere is safe now.

Day 4o — DRIPPING SLIME GOO in the arena! Green goo oozing over the step ledges and pooled either side of the Slime Mixer, like the machine has been running for years and nobody ever cleaned up. Slime goo is a piece in my level builder now too.

Day 4n — RUSTY IRON GRATES bolted onto the arena walls in Level 8 — and there's something small lurking behind the bars. Four of them, two each side, sitting back behind everything. Iron grate is a piece in my level builder now too.

Day 4m — Bug #13, caught by our tester! Saving Level 8 in the builder made the Slime Mixer vanish and left the checkpoint flag hovering above the ground. The builder had an old copy of itself running and didn't know what a mixer WAS, so it quietly left it out. Fixed both — and the hovering-flag part is fixed for every level anyone ever builds.

Day 4l — THE SLIME MIXER AND MY OWN ARENA — LEVEL 8! A sealed stone arena with steps climbing both sides to a strange MACHINE in the middle. Stomp the top to switch it on and slimes pour out of it, lobbing through the air, wave after wave, five of them, each wave bigger. Beat them all and the machine cracks open and fountains coins. The exit flag stays locked until the machine is beaten. Decked out with my waving grass, my rocks and my big x-ray boulders.

Day 4k — TIME PENALTY! In Time Trial, starting a level over now costs you THREE SECONDS. It builds up across the whole run — restart on level 2 and again on level 7 and that's 6 seconds — and it lands on your FINAL TIME and on the record you sign. A red line on the timer shows exactly what you've spent, so it's never a nasty surprise. Normal play is free: restart all you like.
Day 4j — A giant RAINBOW arches over the mountain summit in Level 7, way behind everything, right above where the Great Eagle waits. Painted it double-size so it towers over the whole arena.

Day 4i — KAM IS THE CHAMPION! First name ever on the Hard Run — and not just once: four runs, 2:13.19, then 1:39.88, then 2:11.78, then 1:46.37. The 1:39.88 smashed the old best of 2:02.73 by nearly 23 whole seconds.

Day 4h — The LEVEL SELECT scrolls sideways now! Your seven levels were 546 wide on a 440 screen, so level 1 and level 7 were hanging off both edges. Now the row slides, with a scroll bar under it — and the arrow keys drag it along, so both ends are always reachable no matter how many levels you build.

Day 4g — The main menu SCROLLS now! Adding the Hard Run had pushed the bottom of the menu off the screen. Now the menu stays centred and hugs its buttons like always, but once there are too many runs to fit, a scroll bar appears — and moving the highlight with the arrows drags the view along, so a button can never hide below the edge.

Day 4f — Bug #12, caught by our tester! On the high-score name screen, ANY key you touched slammed it shut and saved a half-typed name. Now WASD steers the letters as well as the arrows, stray keys do nothing at all, and only JUMP signs your name.
Day 4e — Your CAPE shadows too! It gets its own dark blue shadow behind you when you're inside a Big Rock, layered exactly like the real thing. Anything you wear in future is covered automatically.

Day 4d — X-RAY ROCKS! When you (or a slime) walk behind a Big Rock, you don't vanish any more — you show right through the stone as a dark blue shadow. It follows you exactly, even which way you're facing.

Day 4c — Painted a tuft of tall green GRASS — and it WAVES! It leans back and forth in the wind, rooted at the bottom so only the blades move. Every tuft sways on its own beat, so a whole patch ripples instead of moving in lockstep. Waving grass is a piece in my level builder now.
Day 4b — I built my own CHALLENGE RUN — the HARD RUN! Five of my toughest levels back to back (2, 4, 5, 6, 7), against the clock, all picked by me. It's in my game's menu now.

Day 4a — Bug #11, caught by our tester! You could walk off the FAR RIGHT edge of the world at the end of a level and fall forever. Now every single level has an invisible wall there, just like the one on the left. The world holds you in on both ends now.
Day 3h — A second kind of rock! Big chunky BOULDERS now sit on the mountain in Level 7 alongside the round ones — and Big Rock is its own piece in your level builder too.
Day 3g — Painted a REAL ROCK! The grey rocks scattered up the Level 7 mountain (and the Rock piece in your level builder) are no longer plain stone blocks — they're proper round mountain rocks now.
Day 3f — Scattered grey ROCKS up the mountain in Level 7! And Rock is a real piece in your level builder now too — pick it and place it in any level you build.
Day 3e — THE EAGLE LEARNED TWO NEW TRICKS! Between dives he now fans three feathers straight at you, and when you finally bring him down he goes out in a two-second storm of his own feathers.
Day 3d — Bug #10, caught by our tester! The smasher flames were frozen in place instead of riding along with the platform. Fixed — they hover with it now.
Day 3c — Painted a downward-pointing FLAME and lined four of them up under every SMASHER platform in the game — Level 2 and Level 5 both look way cooler now when the smasher comes crashing down.

Day 3b — A whole NEW MOUNTAIN — LEVEL 7! Climb the cliffs up to a wide stone summit where a GREAT GOLDEN EAGLE sits watching. Get close and he takes off, flies way up, then dives right through you corner to corner across the sky. Five stomps to bring the king of the sky down!
Day 3a — Bug #9, caught by our tester! Saving new pieces in the builder could accidentally erase a level's win goal. Fixed for good.
Day 2z — The bird nest is a real piece in your level builder now too — pick it up and move it wherever you want.
Day 2y — A painted twiggy NEST for the Fury Birds, up in the sky in Level 5 near where they patrol!

Day 2x — Bug #8, caught by our tester! The flags used to let you sneak past a fight without finishing it. Now they DEMAND victory: the Throne Room flag stays grey until the King Slime falls, and Level 5's flag needs all THREE Fury Birds down. Your goal shows right under your hearts and checks off green when you've done it.
Day 2w — The blue star is a real piece in your level builder now too — pick it and drop it into your own levels.

Day 2v — SKY CHARGE! A glowing blue star crystal in Level 5 — hold your dash button to squeeze down like a spring, let go, and BLAST OFF four jumps high! Grab a second star while you're charged and it tops up half of what you're missing, just like the fire flower.

Day 2u — YOU rebuilt Level 5 in the level builder — ALL BY YOURSELF! A THIRD red fury bird, cracked walls, vine curtains, a smash crystal, more hearts, and two healing pools now guard the road to the King.
Day 2t — A whole NEW Level 5 built to lead up to the King! Spikes, two SLAMMER traps, and two RED FURY BIRDS guard the path — beat it and you fly straight into the Throne Room, now Level 6.
Day 2s — Two more red banners in the Throne Room — one on each side of the King, standing tall just above the floor.
Day 2r — The grey STONE FLOOR from the King's throne room is in your level builder now! Pick it from the pieces list and drop it into YOUR OWN levels.
Day 2q — THE KING SLIME LEARNED A JUMP ATTACK! He leaps way up in the air and SLAMS down — get out from under him! He now takes turns between charging, spitting slime, and the slam.
Day 2p — The King Slime now takes FIVE stomps to beat instead of three — a real boss battle!
Day 2o — THE KING SLIME CAN SHOOT NOW! He alternates between charging at you and spitting a slime shot from far away — no more safe spot to just wait him out.
Day 2n — The King Slime fight is fairer now — once you bonk him on the head, you have to touch the ground again before another bonk counts. No more chain-stomping him out of the air!
Day 2m — The Throne Room is a real CASTLE now! Grey stone sky, a grey stone brick floor, and a red banner with a golden lion hanging above the king's throne.
Day 2l — Bug #7, caught by our tester! The clouds were floating IN FRONT of birds and coins instead of behind them. Now clouds always stay in the sky where they belong, behind everything.
Day 2k — A real golden THRONE now sits behind the King Slime in his throne room — painted just for him!

Day 2j — THE KING SLIME! A huge crowned slime boss with his OWN throne room — a brand new button on the title screen. He rests, then CHARGES at you fast, and it takes THREE stomps to bring him down. His health floats over him as a green bar.

Day 2i — Bug #6, caught by our tester! LEVEL 3 and LEVEL 4 were missing the invisible wall at the start, so you could walk off the left edge and fall. Fixed both, and every level built from now on gets that wall automatically — no more falling off the start, ever.
Day 2h — A big golden PLAY! button on the title screen! Click it to jump straight into the game.
Day 2g — A GIANT DINOSAUR now looms in the background of LEVEL 4 — way in the distance, but absolutely huge!
Day 2f — Fixed a bug caught by our tester! The sky clouds used to jump back to the start when they finished drifting — now they glide back and forth smoothly, no jump.

Day 2e — GETTING HEARTS BACK! Two hearts are hiding in level 2 (one past the spikes, one way up on the tallest platform), slimes and hawks sometimes drop a heart when you squash them, and there's a healing fountain near the start that fills your hearts back up slowly while you stand in it. Hearts and the fountain are in your level builder now too, ready for level 3 and level 4!

Day 2d — MOVING PLATFORMS in level 2! Ride one across a gap, watch out for the SMASHER that slams down spikes from above, and dodge the SHOVER that knocks you sideways off a ledge (that one's a safe push, no hearts lost).

Day 2c — THE SMASH POWER! Find the sparkly crystal in level 1 or 2 and your dash gets strong enough to break cracked walls and cut through vine curtains — and you keep it the whole level. Both kinds of barriers are in both levels now, and they're in your level builder too!
Day 2b — A new "Add Sky Clouds" button in the level builder! One click and your level gets the same clouds, spacing, and heights as levels 1 and 2.
Day 2a — The Boss Hawk is in YOUR level builder too now! It's on the pieces list — drop him wherever you want in your own levels.
Day 1z — A BOSS HAWK! Near the end of level 2, a huge angry red hawk swoops in — twice the size of a normal one.

Day 1y — CONTROLLER MODE! Plug in a real controller and play like a console game — X to jump, Square to dash, Triangle for fireballs — and it BUZZES in your hands when you jump, land hard, or get hurt.
Day 1x — Bug #5, caught by our tester! The cape was staying behind at the start instead of following you — now it sticks right with you wherever you go.
Day 1w — A blue cape! Your guy wears it now, and it flutters as he moves.
Day 1v — Bug #4, caught by our tester (he out-tested his own game maker on this one)! Your guy was actually facing backward both ways this whole time — fixed for good.
Day 1u — Bug #3, caught by our tester! The empty heart icon was only drawn half-empty, making it look like hits weren't really landing. Fixed the picture so an empty heart looks properly empty now.
Day 1t — Bug #2, caught by our tester! The hawk was flying facing the wrong way — now it faces where it's actually going.
Day 1s — A FIERCE hawk now swoops through the sky in level 1, painted just for you and the same size as you! Jump on it, dash it, or fireball it to take it down.
Day 1r — Fixed the first official bug — caught by our tester! You can't fall off the very start of the world anymore when you walk left.
Day 1q — Real fluffy clouds! The sky clouds got a paint job instead of being fuzzy white blobs, and no more white boxes around them either.
Day 1p — Fireballs are bigger now, and when one hits a slime it splits into THREE little fire sparks that shoot outward!

Day 1o — FIREBALLS! Grab the little flame in level 1 (the middle jump bit) or level 2 (right at the start) and press E to shoot bouncing fireballs that cook slimes from far away for 20 seconds. Grab another flame while it's going and it tops up half of what you're missing.
Day 1n — A level picker! Pick your level right from the title screen — or press M while paused to jump back to it.
Day 1m — Clouds are HUGE now and they slowly float across the sky to the right!
Day 1l — Clouds are bigger and hang lower now, there are twice as many of them, and a few extra-puffy ones are mixed in.
Day 1k — Fluffy clouds floating in the sky in both levels!
Day 1j — A springy pad in level 2! Land on it and BOING — it launches you way higher than a normal jump, straight toward the tallest platform.
Day 1i — Dash straight through a slime and it pops! No need to jump on its head anymore if you're zooming.
Day 1h — Dash! Hold a direction and press SHIFT to zoom forward super fast — works on the ground AND in mid-air.
Day 1g — The jumps in level 2 are higher and trickier now — same length, just a lot more jumpy!
Day 1f — A whole NEW level! Reach the flag at the end of level 1 and it zooms you straight into level 2 — longer, more slimes, more spikes, more coins, and a trickier jumping staircase near the end.
Day 1e — The slime pop burst now matches the double jump blue exactly!
Day 1d — The slime pop burst is an even brighter blue now!
Day 1c — The slime pop burst is blue now instead of red!
Day 1b — Slimes go out with a bang! Stomp one and it now pops in a burst of red particles.

Day 1 — Double jump! Press jump again while you're in the air to jump again, with a big blue particle poof shooting down when you do it. The landing dust puff got bigger too, and now it grows even MORE the higher up you fell from!
Day 0c — Proper letters! The words in the game are pixel letters now instead of boring computer ones. Also little puffs of dirt kick up when you land from a big jump.
Day 0b — Dad put the real art in! Now there is a green space guy, a blue slime, gold coins, grass and dirt, spikes, a red flag, and music that plays while you run around.
Day 0 — Dad set up the game. It has a guy who can run and jump, coins to collect, three slimes to squash, spikes to avoid, a checkpoint flag and a goal flag at the end.
